scope: Measured complete Qwen3-1.7B replay with 18 prompt and 8 generated tokens. Functional frontend executes the ISA and derives timing metadata; its timer does not isolate pure GEMM. Other time is the residual, including initialization, verification and process overhead.
bound_scope: Arithmetic upper bound assuming the entire functional frontend disappears, other stages unchanged; not a measured optimization. Functional numerical execution is still required for data-dependent generation.
